# Import request signal. The record-level states stay dormant until the
# game-start on_action explicitly requests an import.
xar_import_request_check = {
	type = character
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = xa_import_requested
			global_var:xa_import_requested = 1
		}
		localization_key = xar_import_request_on
	}
	text = { localization_key = xar_import_request_off fallback = yes }
}

# XAR_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY_BEGIN
# Test-only bridge signal: asks xar_meta to open the player character window.
xar_trait_hover_check = {
	type = character
	text = {
		trigger = { has_character_flag = xa_trait_hover_test_pending }
		localization_key = xar_trait_hover_sentinel
	}
	text = { localization_key = xar_trait_hover_off fallback = yes }
}
# XAR_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY_END
